subject: Encord x LanceDB Multimodal Leaders SF Dinner - May 21st
text:
Hi [NAME],

Our co-founder, [SENDER] <[LINK]>,
is co-hosting an exclusive dinner for multimodal AI leaders alongside
LanceDB on Thursday, May 21. We would love to invite you to join us.

We have reserved a private waterfront room at Angler SF
<[LINK]>
for ~20 CxOs and technology executives from companies like Midjourney,
Netflix, and Adobe to facilitate focused discussion. The evening will focus
on building and scaling multimodal systems covering vision, audio, and
language along with the underlying data challenges.

For context, Encord is the AI data platform teams use to build and
fine-tune proprietary models at scale. We help over 200 teams, including
AbbVie, TwelveLabs, and Veriff, curate the right training data, run
annotation and RLHF workflows, and evaluate model quality as their systems
evolve.

Please let me know if you are available that evening or if you want to
substitute a colleague. I'm happy to share more details.

subject: World models webinar
text:
Hey [NAME] - nice to meet you!

We recently hosted a deep-dive webinar on the future of AI in robotics -
thought you would've found the discussion relevant.

We brought together Chris Paxton (AI Lead at Agility) and Jason Ma
(Co-founder at Dyna) for a conversation moderated by Encord CEO [SENDER] and Head of Physical AI [SENDER] to debate a central question: "Will
World Models Eat Physical AI?"

The discussion focused on World Models vs. VLAs, real-world deployment
trade-offs, and the data pipelines powering current humanoid and robotics
systems.

Attaching the recording here
<[LINK]>
-
we hope you enjoy the session, and I'd love to hear your thoughts!

subject: Encord x Yoti: Age verification at scale
text:
Hey [NAME],

Congrats on the iBeta Level 3! First in the world is a big deal, especially
with the UK social media regulation conversation moving so fast.

You've proven your liveness tech is best in class. Keeping pace now means
solving for annotation quality at volume, biometric data with expiry and
regulatory constraints, and getting off scripts and ad hoc datasets before
the market demands it.

We work with teams like Entrust/Onfido on exactly this. Do you have 15
minutes next week?

subject: Micromine deal - quick intro
text:
Hi [NAME],

Saw the Micromine deal recently closed and figured now was a good time to
reach out.

My company Encord helps perception teams from surveillance (Flock Safety)
to autonomous robotics (Boston Dynamics) on the data side of model
development : annotation, curation, and model eval.

I'd guess annotation and curation are a priority right now, since the team
is likely ingesting more data and finding edge cases in mine-site footage
becomes a bigger problem. Having curation and annotation in the same tool
has saved our partners a lot of time and produced strong training data
quality.

Would be interesting to show you how we approach this.

subject: model performance feedback loop
text:
Hi [NAME], 

 We recently began working with Veriff and Onfido, and [COMPANY] came up given your work in the IDV space.  

 One theme we're hearing a lot: once models are live, the challenge shifts to diagnosing failure modes and tightening the loop between training data and production - especially in high-staked KYC/AML settings.  

 Curious if that's something you're seeing as well on your side? 

 Happy to compare notes if useful. I'm usually flexible Tue - Thu.

text:

based on that thought it might be a good moment to reach out,

across silos for labelling and ML work is a challenge for CoE,

perspectives on how different teams are approaching this, would you have
some time next week?
